CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2775 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 3b5ffde573c4557f8af68a4905f1ffe94bba7da8. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 3b5ffde573c4557f8af68a4905f1ffe94bba7da8 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-learner-eta-r5, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-learner-eta-r5 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-learner-eta-r5; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from PR #2775 head 3b5ffde573c4557f8af68a4905f1ffe94bba7da8 (branch fix/r10-learner-eta-r3; round-4 handoff is handoff/r10-learner-eta-r4, tip b6dad803a2fe8184a0e5cd3d80f36d3eb0ac0182); do not restart from main. Merge origin/main first.
Round 4 verdict, blocked at 3b5ffde5 (git show origin/review/2775:VERDICT.md; read it whole). First line: "contract-incomplete: learner_progress reaches no entity the card reads; ModelStatusSensor, the Health tab's only source, drops it".
The fix: make learner_progress reach the card. ModelStatusSensor must carry it as the Health tab's source. Failing test FIRST: a test that reads an entity attribute the card reads (the Health tab's source) and finds learner_progress; show it red at the head, then green after the fix, plus a null control (a settled learner, or no learner_progress, publishes no such attribute / the card falls back as before).
This is round 5: the three-round rule binds. You RE-CUT, you do not repair: write a MINIMAL body carrying only figures re-taken in this pass, each with command and result. If the card wiring is too large for this round, SPLIT the PR: the learner_progress module and payload land here; the card/sensor wiring becomes a follow-up group, carried by its group id on a live roster group (Forward-carry with verbatim text, plain statement in `## Head`), and the PR's claims must then not promise the card shows it.
Push handoff/r10-learner-eta-r5 (new 40-hex tip) and handoff-body/r10-learner-eta-r5.
no host or home paths in anything you push
